questions.question: In the summary, what does the word "slips" mean?
questions.explain_en: "Slips" means the index fell or dropped a little, as shown by the lower closing number.
questions.explain_zh: 「slips」在文中指的是指數稍微下跌，正如收盤數字下降所示。
questions.news_title_en: TAIEX slips 210 points as TSMC late-session selloff drags index back below 46,000

questions.question: How much did TSMC's share price change in the afternoon?
questions.explain_en: The summary says TSMC fell NT$40, which is a drop of 1.64%.
questions.explain_zh: 摘要中說台積電下跌 NT$40，跌幅為 1.64%。
questions.news_title_en: TAIEX slips 210 points as TSMC late-session selloff drags index back below 46,000

questions.question: In the summary, what does the word "anchor" mean?
questions.explain_en: Here "anchor" means to secure or establish something firmly, i.e., TSMC wants to firmly establish AI-era capacity in Taiwan.
questions.explain_zh: 這裡的「anchor」指的是穩固或確立，意指台積電想在台灣穩固 AI 時代的產能。
questions.news_title_en: TSMC opens Technology Symposium, spotlighting supply-chain collaboration and advanced-packaging roadmap

questions.question: According to the summary, how much higher is the projected output of the 2nm node compared to the 3nm node in its first year?
questions.explain_en: The summary states that the 2nm output is projected to run about 45% higher than the 3nm in its first year.
questions.explain_zh: 摘要中說明 2nm 的產能在第一年預計比 3nm 高約 45%。

questions.question: In the text, what does the word "tap" mean?
questions.explain_en: Here "tap" means to draw out or access the US$8 trillion market.
questions.explain_zh: 這裡的 "tap" 指的是開發或利用這個 8 兆美元的市場。
questions.news_title_en: Global private banks chase Taiwan's US$8tn wealth pool as Kaohsiung asset-management hub takes shape

questions.question: Which city has a new asset-management center with relaxed regulatory requirements?
questions.explain_en: The summary states the Kaohsiung Asia Asset Management Center was established with relaxed regulations.
questions.explain_zh: 摘要中提到高雄亞洲資產管理中心設立，且有較寬鬆的監管要求。
